coreStorageClaudeDebugKept: Logs of running sessions and logs written in the last 10 minutes

coreStorageClaudeSnapshotsKept: Snapshots a running Claude Code may be using (created after the oldest process started)
coreStorageClaudePasteWhat: Large blocks of text pasted in the terminal (~/.claude/paste-cache), only used to recall them from input history (Up arrow); once deleted, those history entries show only a placeholder
coreStorageClaudePasteKept: Text pasted since a running Claude Code started
coreStorageClaudeImageCacheWhat: Copies Claude Code keeps of images in conversations (~/.claude/image-cache); it also clears other sessions' copies when it starts
coreStorageClaudeTelemetryWhat: Usage statistics that failed to send and are waiting to be resent (~/.claude/telemetry)
coreStorageAptWhat: Packages and package index cache downloaded by apt (cleared with apt-get clean as root); they're downloaded again when you install software
coreStorageAptKept: Nothing is cleared while software is being installed
coreStorageNpmWhat: npm's download cache and logs (~/.npm/_cacache, _logs), the same as npm cache clean deletes
coreStorageNpmKept: Packages installed by npx (~/.npm/_npx), which MCP servers may be running from; nothing is cleared if npm started less than 10 minutes ago
coreStoragePipKept: Nothing is cleared while pip is running
coreStorageTmpWhat: Your temporary files in Debian's /tmp, including Claude Code's command output and scratch folders (/tmp/claude-<uid>)
coreStorageTmpKept: Anything changed in the last day, open in a process or used as a working folder, with sockets (tmux, ssh, etc.), or from running sessions
